script:
$hermesDir = "C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes"
"=== restoring clean config ==="
Copy-Item "$hermesDir\hermes-agent\cli-config.yaml.example" "$hermesDir\config.yaml" -Force
"Restored clean config"
"=== applying model settings via Python (safe YAML) ==="
python3 <<'PYEOF'
import re
p = r"C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes\config.yaml"
text = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()
# Use precise replacements on the default values
text = text.replace('default: "stealth/space-bunny-alpha"', 'default: "space-bunny-free"')
# Find provider line under model: section and replace
text = re.sub(r'(?m)^  provider: "nous"$', '  provider: "custom"', text)
text = text.replace('base_url: "https://inference-api.nousresearch.com/v1"', 'base_url: "https://opencode.ai/zen/v1"')
open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(text)
print("Model settings applied")
PYEOF
"=== verifying ==="
$env:Path += ";C:\Users\E\AppData\Local\hermes\bin"
hermes doctor 2>&1 | Select-String "model/provider|space-bunny|custom endpoint" | Select-Object -First 5
